pretraining: Full-official original MSVR310 DeMo50 bestE32 plus additional50/new Adam; original identity encoder fixed

anchor.method: R201Q single contribution-regression-weight factor relative to P: MSVR310 .05->0, RGBNT100 retains.05. The existing prediction/gate head and sigmoid20 are unchanged and receive the original final retrieval-task gradient. Same-state stopped-gallery targets, fixed00 indices and raw regression diagnostics are still computed; no calibrated-contribution claim. P M/F auxiliary weights MSVR.01/RGB100.05, all other full losses, CE.25+hinge.6, partial0 computation/BN2/two backwards, relation-local PI, cap.10, network, parameters/5120D, frozen originalDeMo42, fresh experts/heads/Adam/seed42, P8K8/orders/augmentations/additional50 remain. First test only MSVR matched ordinary/axis on additionally authorized GPU0/1, while original P RGB100 GPU2/3 proceeds unchanged. Preserve K201 best. Four selected P batches motivate this control, not sustained/global conflict, causal proof or a guaranteed normal/missing +1. Full official train/query/gallery, fixed normal benchmark-mAP-best earliest ties/six metrics; paper-six only after normal stage closure, no new49 or failing-direction seed sweep.
anchor.limits: Common context remains auxiliary; coupled gate is not claimed calibrated. Twelve disjoint-source cases lack shared identity coordinates; missing evaluation deferred.

final_unit_descriptor_bound.placement: After complete parent M/F/I aggregation, gates and relation weights; before final deployed return
final_unit_descriptor_bound.inactive_output: Exact original candidate bytes; 00 remains the existing frozen identity path
final_unit_descriptor_bound.limits: Known norm bound; not retrieval correctness or guaranteed +1. K PI10/01 native equality is checked before this new output bound.

anchor.contribution_reference: Stopped-gradient corresponding gallery state; fixed00 positive/negative indices

checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
method_revision: R201Q single contribution-regression-weight factor relative to P: MSVR310 .05->0, RGBNT100 retains.05. The existing prediction/gate head and sigmoid20 are unchanged and receive the original final retrieval-task gradient. Same-state stopped-gallery targets, fixed00 indices and raw regression diagnostics are still computed; no calibrated-contribution claim. P M/F auxiliary weights MSVR.01/RGB100.05, all other full losses, CE.25+hinge.6, partial0 computation/BN2/two backwards, relation-local PI, cap.10, network, parameters/5120D, frozen originalDeMo42, fresh experts/heads/Adam/seed42, P8K8/orders/augmentations/additional50 remain. First test only MSVR matched ordinary/axis on additionally authorized GPU0/1, while original P RGB100 GPU2/3 proceeds unchanged. Preserve K201 best. Four selected P batches motivate this control, not sustained/global conflict, causal proof or a guaranteed normal/missing +1. Full official train/query/gallery, fixed normal benchmark-mAP-best earliest ties/six metrics; paper-six only after normal stage closure, no new49 or failing-direction seed sweep.
partial_training: Unchanged P computation; only MSVR contribution regression weight zero, existing task gates retained.
amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
retention: Only best.pth; smoke strict reload in memory; no initial, last, or smoke weight files
